title: Binance Fixed Rate Loans Upgrades Reward Mechanism for Fund Suppliers
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance  Fixed Rate Loans  is excited to announce the reward mechanism upgrade for fund suppliers. The product upgrade allows fund suppliers to earn Real-Time APR rewards before the supply order is matched. Users can now go to  Binance Simple Earn  and supply funds to Fixed Rate Loan. With the upgrade, the funds supplied through the Simple Earn page will be subscribed to Simple Earn Flexible Products and earn Real-Time APR rewards. After the Fixed Rate Loan supply order is matched, your funds will enter into the fixed term and earn fixed rewards. How to Supply Funds via Simple Earn: Head to  [Simple Earn] , and search for USDT, USDC, FDUSD, or TRX.  Click on [Supply Fund] with the Fixed Rate Supply tag. You can choose to supply funds from Spot Account, Funding Account, and/or Earn Flexible Account. Enter the supply amount and confirm the order. Start earning Real-Time APR rewards before the order is matched. Once the order is matched, your funds will enter into the fixed term and earn fixed rewards. Related information:  What is Binance Fixed Rate Loans Get Started With Binance Fixed Rate Loans Today! About Binance Fixed Rate Loans: Binance Fixed Rate Loans aims to build a stable and user-friendly financial environment by allowing users to customize their interest rate and offering predictable costs/returns for users. The platform effectively matches the needs of suppliers and borrowers. Fixed Rate Loan is over-collateralized, supporting multi-asset collateral to reduce liquidation risk. It also features an efficient automated process with auto-repay and auto-renew options. Managed by Binance, it ensures a smooth and straightforward experience for all users. Notes: Please refer to  Binance Fixed Rate Loans Terms and Conditions   prior to placing any orders on the Binance Fixed Rate Loan platform. This new function is only accessible to users whose total account balance is higher than $50,000. Only supply orders placed from the  Binance Simple Earn  page can be subscribed to Simple Earn Flexible Products and receive Real-Time APR rewards. Orders that are placed from the  Fixed Rate Loan page  directly will only accrue fixed rate rewards after order match. By redeeming the corresponding assets from Simple Earn Flexible Products, users’ Fixed Rate Supply orders may be canceled if the remaining Simple Earn assets cannot fulfil the orders. Orders placed earlier will be canceled first. Users can view their orders by going to Fixed Rate Loan Orders >  Ongoing Orders  or  Pending Orders . Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-02-13
